Hero.title: High-Performance Technological Sovereignty and Spatial Intelligence
Hero.description: I design custom spatial infrastructures for complex operations. Reduce variable logistics costs to zero per request, guarantee actual fleet governance, and gain absolute topological control of your road network.

ValueProp.title: End-to-End Geospatial Pipeline Mastery
ValueProp.description: A rare combination of geographic spatial understanding and robust software engineering. I develop from the spatial database design to the final analytical dashboard, ensuring independence from expensive commercial licenses.

databases.title: Scalable Architectures
databases.description: Spatial database modeling using PostgreSQL and PostGIS optimized for high-volume geographical data.

integration.title: Enterprise Integration
integration.description: Integration of dedicated routing engines directly into existing ERP, WMS, and third-party routing systems.

analytics.title: Advanced Spatial Analytics
analytics.description: Custom algorithm development in pgRouting to translate geographic data into strategic business decisions.

Challenge.title: The Commercial Routing API Trap
Challenge.subtitle: Why are robust fleets paying high costs for generic solutions?
Challenge.description: Proprietary APIs charge for every single route or geocode request. As your operation scales, the bill becomes unpredictable and exorbitant. Furthermore, these APIs cannot accommodate constraints specific to your fleet.
Challenge.card_commercial_desc: Variable and growing costs, dependency on big tech cloud infrastructure, generic traffic restrictions, and bills that scale as your business grows.
Challenge.card_local_desc: Local routing engine hosted in a secure environment. Zero cost per request, minimal latency, total data sovereignty, and fleet rules parameterized to your exact needs.

SomapEngine.title: SOMAP: The Core of Your Sovereignty
SomapEngine.description: SOMAP is not just an off-the-shelf product; it is the architectural foundation I deploy inside your environment. It enables directors and operations managers to visualize spatial data in real-time, manage dynamic workspaces, and perform spatial audits without depending on external licenses.

Pillars.title: Three Pillars of Financial Impact
Pillars.subtitle: Focus is on the financial return and operational efficiency of your routes.
Pillars.routing_desc: Replacing per-call fees with a robust local infrastructure using pgRouting. The number of routes calculated per second stops impacting your bottom line.
Pillars.bi_desc: Spatial BI dashboards matching planned routes with executed ones, enabling detailed audits of fuel consumption, actual mileage, and travel time.
Pillars.topology_desc: Parametrization of custom routing constraints that generic APIs do not offer: vehicle height/weight, urban restrictions by time of day, and risk maps.

CustomEngineering.title: Custom Geospatial Engineering
CustomEngineering.subtitle: High-impact enterprise applications designed and deployed end-to-end.
CustomEngineering.observation_desc: Creation of robust APIs and WebGIS applications integrating engines like Google Earth Engine for automated calculations, environmental monitoring, and vegetation data analysis.
CustomEngineering.logistics_desc: Database development and synchronization for complex governmental logistics, such as school transport fleet management and routing.
CustomEngineering.infrastructure_desc: Configuration and management of large-scale server environments and workspaces, applying GeoServer tuning, format viability testing for field operations, and performance plugin implementation for fast map rendering.
